name: Federico Kirschbaum
biography: Federico Kirschbaum is a security researcher with over two decades of experience building tools and ecosystems for offensive security. He is the Co-Founder and VP of Research in Faraday Security, an open-source platform. He is also the Co-Founder of Ekoparty, Latin America’s largest hacking conference, where he has helped shape the region’s security research community for over 20 years.
